environment.description: AWS Lambda function invoked by API Gateway (HTTP API, no authorization) fronted by a public-facing ALB. The Step Functions workflow is triggered via POST /onboarding/lookup. The ALB security group allows inbound traffic from 0.0.0.0/0 on port 443. No WAF is attached. The API Gateway has no request validation or authorizer configured. The Lambda function has network access to the internal LDAP server via VPC peering.
